name: 70734 · Geismar, LA
findings: ZIP 70734 (Geismar) has 22 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.

Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70734 (Geismar) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
